title: 7 Security Camera Myths That Could Leave You Vulnerable
description: Don't fall for these common security camera myths. The truth about what actually protects your home.
keywords: security camera myths, home security myths, security camera facts, home security tips
content:
Most people believe these myths about security cameras. Here's the truth.

Myth 1: Expensive = Better

Truth: A $30

>Wyze v4 has 2K resolution. Many $200 cameras have lower specs.

Myth 2: You Need Professional Installation

Truth: Most modern cameras take 3 minutes to set up. Scan QR code, connect to WiFi, done.

Myth 3: Night Vision Requires IR

Truth: Color night vision exists.

>Wyze v4 and Ring Spotlight Cam both have it.

Myth 4: Wireless Means No Wires

Truth: "Wireless" means no Ethernet cable. Most still need power cables unless battery-powered.

Myth 5: More Cameras = More Security

Truth: 2-3 well-placed cameras beat 8 poorly placed ones. Coverage angle matters more than quantity.

Myth 6: Storage Requires Cloud Subscription

Truth: Local microSD storage works fine. Wyze,

>Reolink, and others offer free local storage.

Myth 7: Security Cameras Are Just for Burglars

Truth: They also monitor packages, pets, kids, elderly parents, and insurance claims.
